svg.title: Figure 5-1. Gate roadmap with blockers and the 30-day backlog (WP-M-03 §3, §5, §9)
svg.desc: Phases P0 Governance, P1 Concept, P2 System design, P3 HW/SW development, P4 Integration and verification, P5 Validation and release, P6 Operation, each closed by its gate. Gates passed: none. Critical path: P0 → HARA → HARA confirmation review → FFI/DFA → envelope hardening → HIL verification → validation → FSA. Backlog: 6 done, 2 done with an exception, 9 not marked done.
